kind: New authored development counterfactuals; simulated rejection verdicts, no empirical semantic accuracy

cases.source: Alpha management expects growth. Beta management expects a decline.
Customer Jane Smith said: Our orders may grow. Alpha issued the release.
cases.original: Customer Jane Smith said her company’s orders may grow.
cases.proposal: Alpha management said Alpha’s orders will grow.
cases.reason: Customer speech is not issuer management; may is not will.

cases.source: Alpha management reported revenue for fiscal year 2025; fiscal year-end was June 30.
cases.original: Alpha management reported revenue for fiscal year 2025.
cases.proposal: Alpha management reported revenue for calendar year 2025.

cases.source: Published July 30, 2025. Alpha reported capacity as of June 30, 2025.
cases.original: Alpha reported capacity as of June 30, 2025.
cases.proposal: Alpha reported capacity as of July 30, 2025.
cases.reason: Publication date is not measurement date.

cases.source: Alpha management expects a facility to open in 2027.
cases.original: Alpha management expects a facility to open in 2027.

cases.source: Alpha management reported 850 MW of contracted capacity.
cases.original: Alpha management reported 850 MW of contracted capacity.
cases.proposal: Alpha management reported 850 MW of active capacity.

cases.source: Alpha management reported $5 billion of bookings, subject to cancellations.
cases.original: Alpha management reported $5 billion of bookings, subject to cancellations.
cases.proposal: Alpha management reported $5 billion of revenue.
cases.reason: Bookings, backlog and revenue differ; cancellation caveat lost.

cases.source: Alpha management reported approximately $5 billion of revenue, more than $4 billion.
cases.original: Alpha management reported approximately $5 billion of revenue, more than $4 billion.
cases.proposal: Alpha management reported exactly €5 million of revenue, equal to €4 million.
cases.reason: Currency, scale, approximation and inequality all change.

cases.source: Alpha reported adjusted EBITDA excluding stock compensation.
cases.original: Alpha reported adjusted EBITDA excluding stock compensation.
cases.proposal: Alpha reported GAAP net income including stock compensation.
cases.reason: Accounting basis, metric and exclusions change.

cases.source: Alpha management said capacity is illustrative and may not reflect actual locations.
cases.original: Alpha management said capacity is illustrative and may not reflect actual locations.
cases.proposal: Alpha management said capacity reflects actual locations.

cases.source: Alpha management said revenue grew; no comparison period is specified.
cases.proposal: Alpha management said revenue grew year-over-year.
cases.reason: Missing comparison period cannot be invented.

cases.source: Alpha management discussed facility A and facility B and said it might open later.
cases.original: Alpha management said it might open later.
cases.proposal: Alpha management said facility A will open later.
cases.reason: Multiple antecedents require abstention and modality retained.
